subject: Code Task: System-design prompt and timeline
messages:
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>

Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodai.com, monica.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 09:15:00 -0800
Subject: Code Task: System-design prompt and timeline

Hi Elena,

Thanks again for taking the time to interview with Redwood. As discussed in our panel, please find attached the system-design take-home prompt (system-design-task.pdf). A few quick notes: 

- Deliverables: architecture write-up (max 3 pages), sequence diagrams, and a short notes.md with tradeoffs. Sample skeleton is optional.
- Preferred formats: PDF for write-up, PNG/SVG for diagrams, and a single ZIP for code/notes if you include runnable artifacts.
- Deadline: end of day Friday, Dec 9 (we can be flexible if needed; let us know asap).
- Review process: a 30-minute internal rubric review will happen within 48 hours of submission; reviewers are typically the hiring manager + two engineers.

If you'd like a quick clarifying call before you start, I have a 15-min slot tomorrow at 11am PST — reply and I can send a calendar invite.

Links and attachments: rubric (Drive) and the PDF are attached for your convenience.

Best,
Marcus Lin
Senior Staff Engineer, Hiring Team
Redwood Inference

Attachment: system-design-task.pdf (6 pages)
From: Elena Novak <elena.novak@example.com>
To: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 11:05:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Code Task: System-design prompt and timeline

Hi Marcus — thanks, I received the prompt and the rubric. A couple quick questions:

1) Is a runnable prototype required or are design artifacts sufficient?
2) I have a prior commitment the week of the 6th — would it be possible to extend to Monday Dec 13 instead of the 9th?

I can do the 15-min call tomorrow at 11am if that's still available.

Thanks,
Elena

P.S. Preferred submission format is usually a GitHub repo + zip; will that be okay?
From: Marcus Lin <marcus.lin@redwoodai.com>
To: Elena Novak <elena.novak@example.com>
Cc: laura.bennett@redwoodai.com, monica.patel@redwoodai.com
Date: Wed, 02 Dec 2026 13:24:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Code Task: System-design prompt and timeline

Hi Elena — quick responses inline below.

> 1) Is a runnable prototype required or are design artifacts sufficient?
Design artifacts are sufficient; runnable prototype is optional and welcome but not required. Focus on clarity of tradeoffs and how you'd operate at scale.

> 2) I have a prior commitment the week of the 6th — would it be possible to extend to Monday Dec 13 instead of the 9th?
We can extend, but to keep the process moving I can offer a short extension to Monday Dec 13. If you need additional time beyond that, let us know and we'll discuss.

GitHub + zip is perfect. Please include a README with setup and a short runbook for your proposed architecture.

I'll schedule the 15-min clarifying call for tomorrow at 11am PST — sending invite now.

Cheers,
Marcus

On another note, looping in @Laura and @Monica so we can plan reviewer coverage and calendar slots once Elena submits.
From: Laura Bennett <laura.bennett@redwoodai.com>

- Review window: we aim to complete scoring within 48 hours of submission. Proposed times (30-minute blocks) to reserve on short notice: Dec 14 10:00-10:30 PST, Dec 14 14:00-14:30 PST, Dec 15 09:30-10:00 PST.

Action items: 
- Monica/Tessa — reply with your preferred block(s) and whether you'd like the packet ahead of time (I can pre-share a copy).
